quarterly_data.quarter: Uber press release: Uber and Zipline Partner to Bring Drone Delivery to (08-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner Zipline: Uber and Zipline announced a strategic partnership to scale drone delivery across the United States - Zipline drone delivery on Uber Eats will launch across existing Zipline markets with the first deployments later this year and target expansion into dozens of US cities; Uber will make a strategic investment in Zipline, and the companies aim to reach one million drone deliveries per day by the end of 2029. Uber describes building a hybrid delivery network integrating couriers, sidewalk robots and drones.
quarterly_data.figure: one million drone deliveries per day by the end of 2029; first deployments later this year
